text: Two of us rebuild the sales report every Monday from three spreadsheets

We download supplier prices from five portals and paste them into our price list
Project managers chase timesheets from 30 contractors every Monday morning

Staff photograph receipts and finance types them into expenses in QuickBooks
Customer enquiries from the website form get copied into Salesforce by hand
We book delivery slots with the courier on their website for every order
